post.summary: Log out: revoke the Herald token family, then clear both auth cookies.
post.description:
Revocation is best-effort — if Herald is unreachable we still clear the
cookies so the user's session ends locally; the orphaned family dies on its
own when the refresh absolute TTL expires.

302.description: Set app auth cookie and redirect to original app path
Redirect to Herald OAuth authorize endpoint

post.summary: Refresh the browser access token using the `X-Auth-Refresh` cookie.
post.description:
Herald 0.3.3 issues short-lived (900s) access tokens alongside a long-lived
refresh token. Both tokens rotate on every refresh, and **reusing a rotated
refresh token revokes the whole token family** — so the web console must
proactively call this endpoint before `X-Auth` lapses (single in-flight
refresh), never retry concurrently after a 401.

ActionCommandQuery.description:
动作调用历史查询入参。对齐 `PropertyCommandQuery`，额外携带可选
`service_type` 过滤（动作侧的"类型"维度）。分页沿用既有默认值
（`page` 默认 1、`page_size` 默认 10）。

ActionInvocation.description:
Persisted one-shot action/service invocation (thing-model-extension,
design §4.3.2/§5.2). Physically isolated from `PropertyCommand` per design
A2 — one-shot actions (reboot / unlock / buzzer) live in their own table
and reuse the `CommandStatus` enum for state semantics. `params` is the
action input document (free-form JSONB), and `service_type` is the
free-form service identifier routed via the MQTT topic segment.

ActionInvocationView.description:
动作调用视图。字段对齐设计 §4.2.2 GET 响应
（`id / serviceType / params / status / createdTime / updatedTime`），
camelCase 与前端 hook 解包一致。复用既有 `ActionInvocation` 行模型并裁剪
不暴露给前端的 `product_id` / `device_id`（已在查询参数中由调用方持有）。

cleared_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp when alarm was cleared

webhook_status.description:
Webhook status: None = not configured, Some("success") / Some("failed")
/ Some("final_failed"). `failed` means a delivery is still pending
retry; `final_failed` means all retry attempts have been exhausted
(terminal failure, PRD alarm-rule-engine.md §6).

CommandSource.description:
Origin of a `property_command` row. Lets the frontend correlate a desired
delta with its delivery status without inspecting command contents.
Mirrors the `CommandStatus` derive pattern.

componentSn.description: Sub-component SN. Same charset as a device SN (`validate_identifier`).

componentType.description:
Optional type hint. The metadata table's value takes precedence in the

serviceType.description: 服务类型标识，如 `reboot` / `unlock`；协议层不枚举（A4）

CreateActionCommandResponse.description:
`create_service_command` 的响应（设计 §4.2.2 / §5.2）。
`status` 反映入队后的瞬时状态：`pending`（设备未订阅/离线）或 `sent`（在线
且已订阅，drain 已立即投递）。

status.description: 初始 `pending`（设备在线且订阅时可能直接 `sent`）

FactoryChangeLogQuery.description:
Query parameters for `GET /api/admin/factory/sn/{sn}/changes`
(design §4.2.2 D). The repo has no shared `PaginationQuery`; each paginated
endpoint carries its own query struct following the existing convention
(`PropertyCommandQuery` / `CommonQuery` / etc.). `page` is 1-based.

FactoryComponentAssociation.description:
Device ↔ component association. `component_type` is a hint carried at
association time; the metadata table's value takes precedence in views.

FactoryComponentMetadata.description:
Component-level factory metadata. `component_type` is free TEXT (default
'camera'); the DB column constrains the default, not the value set.

FactoryComponentView.description:
Single component in a `FactoryDeviceView` (design §4.2.2 C).

`component_type` prefers the metadata table's value and falls back to the
association table's hint; both absent → `None`. `file_attachments` is an
array (defaults to `[]` when metadata has not arrived).

FactoryDeviceMetadataView.description:
Device-level factory metadata view (design §4.2.2, §5.1). Symmetric to
`FactoryComponentView` minus `componentType`/`componentSn` — devices have no
component type or sub-component SN at this level. `file_attachments` is
normalised from the raw JSONB to an array (Array passthrough, Null → empty,
scalar → wrapped), matching `map_row_to_component_view`.

FactoryDeviceView.description:
Admin merged-view response for a device (design §4.2.2 C).

`device_metadata` carries the device-level factory metadata row when present
(written via `PUT /api/factory/devices/{deviceSn}`), or `null` when no
device-level metadata has been reported yet. `components` is the left-join of
associations with component metadata; components whose metadata has not
arrived yet surface with `metadata: null` and `file_attachments: []` (R3).

oneOf.description:
Device-level factory metadata (symmetric to `FactoryComponentView` minus
componentType/componentSn). `null` when no device-level metadata has been
reported yet.

FactoryMetadataChangeLog.description: Component metadata overwrite log. `before` is NULL on the first report.

Reference to a file attachment uploaded via
`POST /api/factory/file/upload` (design §4.2.2 A).

fileKey.description: S3 object key returned by the presigned POST. Non-empty, ≤ 1024 chars.

S3 object key (same value as `FileAttachment.fileKey`). Non-empty, ≤ 1024 chars,

fileType.description: 客户端可携带的文件类型提示。当前后端不消费此字段（保留），可选。

OtaReport.description:
Device OTA version report (design §5.3).

`version` is received as a spec `"major.minor.patch"` **string**
(e.g. `"1.2.3"`) — the internal packed-integer storage is produced by
`ota_handlers::ota_version_post` via `parse_version_to_int`. The DB
`device_versions.version` column stays `i32`; only the handler/API layer
translates between the wire string and the packed int.

PropertyDesired.description:
Persisted desired state per device. Stores bare desired property values
(no `{value, time}` wrapping, unlike `PropertyLatest`). Upsert follows the
RFC 7396 subset merge (null = delete key) implemented in the repository.

RefreshResponse.description:
Response body of our `/api/auth/refresh` endpoint. The web console schedules
its next proactive refresh from `expires_in` (well before the 15-minute
access-token boundary so we never race the token expiry).

SetDesiredRequest.description:
Set-Desired request body: a partial patch over desired state.

`desired` follows the RFC 7396 subset: non-null values set/overwrite the
desired key, `null` values delete it. An empty object `{}` is rejected by
the handler (US-PA-042 scenario 4) before reaching the repository.

desired.description: 期望属性 patch（RFC 7396 子集：非 null 覆盖、null 删除）

SetDesiredResponse.description:
Set-Desired response: the merged desired document, the delta computed for
this write, and whether a delta command was enqueued for delivery.

delta.description: 本次 Set-Desired 触发的 delta（待收敛属性，裸期望值）

desired.description: 合并后的完整 desired 文档（裸值）

pushed.description: 是否插入了 delta 命令（delta 非空为 true；在线即时/离线排队均为 true）

ShadowQuery.description:
Get-Delta query parameters. Field naming follows the existing
`PropertyCommandQuery` convention (snake_case query keys).

ShadowView.description:
Get-Delta response: the current desired document, the reported snapshot
(kept in the `{value, time}` shape for frontend consistency), and the
per-property delta. Document-level timestamps let the frontend show when
desired / reported were last updated without a per-key metadata layer.

delta.description: 逐属性 delta（裸期望值）；空表示已收敛

desired.description: 当前 desired 文档（裸值）；无则 `{}`

desired_updated_time.description: desired 文档最后更新时间；无 desired 行则 null

reported.description: 当前 reported 快照（沿用 `{value, time}` 结构）；无则 `{}`

reported_updated_time.description: reported 快照最后更新时间；无 reported 行则 null

components.description:
Component list — **full replace** semantics. Items not in this list are
removed; identical-content re-submissions are idempotent (design §6.1
`replace_associations_full_replace_is_idempotent`).

UpsertComponentRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/factory/components/{componentSn}` (design §4.2.2 A).

All fields are optional: `componentType` defaults to `"camera"` (the DB
column default is `"camera"`; the handler substitutes `None` explicitly to
keep the behaviour visible at the API surface rather than relying on the
caller noticing the DB default). `metadata` and `fileAttachments` default to
`{}` and `[]` respectively. A request with every field omitted creates an
empty placeholder row (intentional — callers may upsert associations first).

componentType.description:
Free-text component type (defaults to `"camera"` when omitted). The
schema deliberately does not enumerate values so radar/sensor/etc. can
be added without a migration (design §1.4 D1).

fileAttachments.description:
File-attachment references. Defaults to `[]`. Each `fileKey` must be
obtained from `POST /api/factory/file/upload` first (factory API Key
authentication, NOT the admin/thing upload paths — see design §4.5).

metadata.description: Structured metadata (calibration values, etc.). Defaults to `{}`.

UpsertDeviceMetadataRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/factory/devices/{deviceSn}` (design §4.2.2 —
device-level write, symmetric to `UpsertComponentRequest` but **without
`componentType`**, since devices have no component type).

`metadata` and `fileAttachments` default to `{}` and `[]` respectively. A
request with every field omitted creates an empty placeholder row
(intentional — callers may upsert associations first).

fileAttachments.description:
File-attachment references. Defaults to `[]`. Each `fileKey` must be
obtained from `POST /api/factory/file/upload` first (factory API Key
authentication — see design §4.5).

metadata.description:
Structured device-level metadata (serial-number label, QC report
reference, firmware version, etc.). Defaults to `{}`.
